title: croton scouleri var. genuinus
intro: Croton scouleri var. genuinus, commonly known as Guanacaste, is a plant species that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Central America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Guanacaste include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit analgesic properties. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
